cards.title: The numbered agenda species
cards.does: Two to four numbered rows are revealed one per word and hold at a named idle; form "page" gives the same list a plate of its own, each row stamped with its catalogued icon once its sentence has been read.

phases.name: number writes
phases.does: the row's numeral fades in
phases.trigger: the row's own `at` (else STEP after the previous row)

phases.name: rule draws
phases.does: the nib draws the hairline under the row

phases.name: text rises
phases.does: the row's text rises ROW_DY and fades in

phases.name: hold alive
phases.does: each row holds on its own phase of the idle (breath by default)

phases.name: icon stamps (page form)
phases.does: the row's catalogued cutout falls onto the page and squashes on impact, once that row's sentence has been read (E93)
phases.trigger: PAGE_STAMP_LAG after the row's own `at` + NUM_LEAD + ROW_S

blends.source: E93 an agenda row carries an icon, stamped on once its sentence has been read

options.means: `form: "page"` is the agenda's ONE named form - the plate version of the list (E99 s16). Absent is the dock form, byte-identical to what it always was; any other word is refused by name.
form=page: the rows divide the whole board, each on a mount with its numeral in a medallion, under a title, and each carries a catalogued icon (E93/E94) stamped on after its sentence.

cards.title: The vector map arc species
cards.does: A clothoid arc draws from one place to another on the word, struck with an X when the flow is cut.

phases.name: shaft draws
phases.does: the clothoid draws by length from one place to the other

phases.name: head lands
phases.does: the arrowhead draws over the last share of the clock

phases.name: cut
phases.does: an X is struck at the midpoint and the arc dims (the X does not)

lives.note: from = VECMAP_GULF written out (golden :565); plate must be vecmap

cards.title: The balance scale, and the balance tips

aliases.name: Balance scale (a tip, or a flag / scale / flag trio)

cards.does: Two NAMED forces weighed in the page's room: the fulcrum and beam draw on the word, each side's load lands on its own word, the beam leans to a lone load and settles level; a tip swings it toward one side with one overshoot.

author.key: species[] {"kind": "balance", "at", "dur", "target": region, "left": {label, at, icon? | prop?, mass?, tone?}, "right": {...}, "tip"?: {at, to: left | right}, "idle"?, "ink"?} (shot row 7th element); a label never carries a digit (two bars)

phases.name: the scale draws
phases.does: the domed foot and the tapered post, then the two clothoid arms out of the pivot, then each pan's hangers and bowl, by length; a fill follows its outline, and the base's resting hatch rises

phases.name: a load lands and the beam leans
phases.does: the side's glyph, prop or name drops into its pan by stopaction's landXf; at the contact the beam takes LEAN_DEG toward it on its spring - both sides weighed, the two steps cancel and it settles level
phases.trigger: each side's `at`; the beam at its contact (landXf's ANTIC_S + DROP_S)

phases.name: the balance tips
phases.does: the beam swings to TIP_DEG toward `tip.to` on an underdamped spring - one visible overshoot, the swing back under a degree - while the pans hang plumb

phases.name: it leaves
phases.does: the whole object goes down in opacity over the window's last EXIT_S

blends.became: the beam's lean, level and tip
the arms, the hangers, the bowls and the foot
a load dropped into its pan

blends.source: the chip's landing fade and sourced glyph (species/chip.mjs chipLand, chipGeometry)
T6b's resting hatch (the engine's propHatchLines, PROP_SHADOW)

options.means: `neg | pos | neutral` on a side (P72 T41, R26-334; Bravos CHN 113/114): its name as a PILL in the sign ink; opt-in, any other value refused by name; form = BALANCE.TONE.FORM

cards.title: The icon chip species
cards.does: A card with one sourced glyph and a label lands on its word; later it is crossed out, or ticked, or a SELL / BUY tab lands on its edge - and a lit chip holds a halo (the one actor of a set).

phases.name: land
phases.does: the card springs from POP_FROM and falls DROP_PX onto its word, fading in

phases.name: hold alive
phases.does: holds on its named idle

phases.name: cross out
phases.does: two X strokes draw one after the other and the card dims

phases.name: lit
phases.does: a halo LIT_PAD outside the card in the focus yellow, glowing in its ink, comes up with the landing and HOLDS (0 events, s91); `pulse: true` blinks it PULSE_N times from the settle (an event per onset, s99)
phases.trigger: `state: "lit"` (the species' `at`); the blinks from at + LAND_S

phases.name: tick
phases.does: a small disc badge in the positive ink centred ON the card's top edge (HIS 06:13) springs in, its charcoal check drawn in two strokes; the card keeps its ink and the icon is never covered
phases.trigger: `tick_at`, a later word (never with `cross_at` or a `tab`)

phases.name: tab
phases.does: a rounded SELL (negative ink) or BUY (positive ink) pill centred ON the card's top edge, half above it, its word in charcoal at the s90 floor, the pill hugging it, landing on the badge spring

blends.source: the curvature stroke for the X (42 s42.1)
Bravos A36 / F3 - the active actor tile glows, a halo behind it (BUB #20)
blends.became: the lit halo and its pulse

blends.source: Bravos A14 - the check badge (BUB #40, HIS 06:07)
Bravos A59 - BUY / SELL state tabs (JPN 04:08, 05:34; DOM 17:30)

options.means: `arrive: "stamp"` on the stamp form only (P70 T1): lands by stampXf - down from 2.1x, off-square, ring fitted to the room, exit owed inside dur, label at the s90 floor - AS A SEAL (P70 T1b, E99 s121)
a stamped chip's GOLD seal only (E99 s121, s123): one short line on the TOP half-arc, left to right, at the source's size; past the ring's side it is WARNed and not drawn (s113)
... and on the BOTTOM half-arc, its own left-to-right arc so it reads upright (badge-stamp.tsx ringTextBottom)
`on` | `crossed` | `lit` (P71 T12, A36: the ONE actor of a set the sentence is about; a held halo is 0 events, s91). Refused on the stamp form
`pulse: true`, a lit chip only (P71 T12): the halo BLINKS PULSE_N times, an event per onset (s99); refused off a lit chip, when not true, or when the window cannot hold the blinks
a later word in the window (P71 T12, A14: a tick for what held, an X for what failed): the two-stroke badge; refused with `cross_at` / `state: crossed` (held or failed) or with a `tab` (one edge)
`sell` | `buy` (P71 T12, A59: who must sell, who buys - H row 10's SELL); a NUMBER is refused by name (never imply a trade record)
the tab's own word, a later one inside the window; absent, the tab lands with the chip; refused without a `tab`

cards.title: The isometric count array species
cards.does: N identical sourced icons arrive in reading order on a 2:1 rhombus lattice and the count is written under them.

phases.name: icons arrive
phases.does: one icon per word lands on the chip's spring in reading order on the 2:1 lattice
phases.trigger: at + i x STEP (or the row's `step`)

phases.name: claim writes
phases.does: the count pops in under the field (0.72 -> 1.0)
phases.trigger: CLAIM_LAG after the last icon settles

phases.name: hold alive
phases.does: every cell holds on its own phase of the idle (breath by default)

cards.title: The equation row, in spoken order

aliases.name: Equation row: inputs, relation, signed result

cards.does: 2-3 sourced inputs written by the hand, each on its own word and optionally named, the operators set between, "=" with the signed result on its word - computed from the written text in its units; an untrue row is refused.

author.key: species[] {"kind": "equation", "at", "dur", "target": region, "terms": [{text, value, at, src (+ tier) | tier: scenario, label?}] (2-3), "ops": [x | − | + | ÷] (one fewer), "result": {text, at, value?, label?}, "idle"?} (shot row 7th element); units $ £ € ¥ % pts x and the scales K M B T

phases.name: a term is written
phases.does: on its own word the hand writes the input glyph by glyph (the figure's figureGlyph), in chalk at its slot

phases.name: an operator springs
phases.does: the operator (×, −, +, ÷) pops in on springPop just before the next term's word, set in the sans (Inter), never the hand
phases.trigger: OP_LEAD before the next term's `at`; over OP_S

phases.name: = and the result
phases.does: "=" springs, and the signed result is written on its word - a negative one with its minus, in the page's neg token (E28)

phases.name: a caption names it
phases.does: an optional label under a term or the result, in the page's quiet ink at the s90 floor, arriving with its item; the numbers stand a measured 1.5x cap step above it, and a tight region gives up daylight, never the numbers

phases.name: the row leaves
phases.does: the whole row fades over the window's last OUT_S

blends.became: the row's halo over a bar or a line

cards.title: The flow diagram species
cards.does: Two to six named things and the clothoid arrows between them draw on - in a row, or on a RING when the chain closes; later one node swaps while the rest stands, and tokens can ride the arrows.

phases.name: frame draws
phases.does: the dashed box draws clockwise from the top-left, dash by dash

phases.name: nodes land
phases.does: chips land one after another on the chip's spring
phases.trigger: BOX_LEAD of the frame's draw, then every NODE_STEP

phases.name: arrows draw
phases.does: clothoid arrows draw one at a time by length; each head lands over the last share of its clock
phases.trigger: EDGE_LAG after the last node lands

phases.name: tokens ride
phases.does: from tokens.from_at, n dots (a chalk core, the arrow ink as rim, a bloom halo) ride every DRAWN arrow by arc length at one speed, no arrow crossed faster than Bravos (0.49 s), fading at each end
phases.trigger: `tokens.from_at`, never before each arrow is drawn

phases.name: year stamps
phases.does: the tag springs in at the box's top-right corner

phases.name: swap
phases.does: the named node's landing runs backward and fades, then the new node lands in its place while the rest stand

blends.source: Bravos loop and money tokens (BUB frame_0058, DOM 03:30)

options.means: `layout: "ring"` (P71 T11): a CLOSED chain on the ellipse in the box, first node at 12 o'clock, clockwise, each arrow leaving along the ring; an open chain is refused. Absent is the row
`tokens: {from_at, n?, speed?, glyph?}` (P71 T11, A27): money moving on the arrows - a plain dot in the arrow's ink (A2a), the sourced coins glyph only by name; one event at from_at

cards.title: The focus zoom species

phases.name: hold dead still
phases.does: the servo law: no drift once there

cards.title: The freeze beat: the stage stops

aliases.name: a light that comes on as everything else STOPS

cards.does: On its word every idle, drift and ambient life on the stage holds for 0.4-1.2 s while ONE light comes on at a datum, a mark or a prop; then life resumes where it stopped. The freeze is the event (E99 s99), not a still frame.

author.key: species[] {"kind": "freeze", "at", "dur", "target"} (shot row 7th element); dur 0.4-1.2 s; target a datum, a point or a region

phases.name: the stage stops, the light comes on
phases.does: every life on the stage (idles, drift, Ken Burns, the live page's spark, the caption boil, an ambient clip) holds on the life clock; one light comes on at the target
phases.trigger: the species' `at`; the light over ON_S (at most RAMP_MAX of the beat)

phases.name: the held frame
phases.does: the frame holds bit-identical with the light on - the light does not breathe; M18 reads the run as punctuation

phases.name: life resumes
phases.does: the light goes and every idle carries on from where it stopped, one beat behind t
